title: OpenTelemetry and dashboard foundation

acceptance_gates.description: The required trace tree is emitted and critical-path trace coverage is at least 95%.
Prohibited attributes (raw prompts, credentials, personal data) never appear in traces, logs or metrics, verified by a redaction test.
Required metrics are exported, and run IDs and user IDs are absent from metric dimensions.

rollback: Revert the FND-OTEL-001 commits; no phase may advance while this package is incomplete.
